items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, by default it only encodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level since it allows combined usage with other general purpose JSON encoders like JacksonCborEncoder without conflicts.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，默认情况下仅对带有@Serializable注解的类型或泛型级别进行编码，因为它允许与其他通用 JSON 编码器（如JacksonCborEncoder）结合使用而不会产生冲突。

items.source: Alternative constructors with a Predicate<ResolvableType> parameter can be used to customize this behavior. For example, new KotlinSerializationCborEncoder(type -> true) will encode all types supported by Kotlin Serialization, including unannotated Kotlin enumerations, numbers, characters, booleans and strings.
items.translation: 带有 `Predicate<ResolvableType>` 参数的替代构造函数可用于自定义此行为。例如，`new KotlinSerializationCborEncoder(type -> true)` 将编码 Kotlin Serialization 支持的所有类型，包括未注释的 Kotlin 枚举、数字、字符、布尔值和字符串。

items.source: Construct a new encoder using Cbor.Default instance which only encodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 使用仅编码在类型或泛型级别上标注了 `@Serializable` 的类型的 `Cbor.Default` 实例来构建一个新的编码器。

items.source: Construct a new encoder using Cbor.Default instance which only encodes types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 使用返回指定谓词为 `true` 的 `Cbor.Default` 实例构建一个新的编码器，该编码器仅编码对应的类型。

items.source: Construct a new encoder using the provided Cbor instance which only encodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 使用提供的 `Cbor` 实例构建一个新的编码器，该编码器仅编码在类型或泛型级别上标注了 `@Serializable` 的类型。

items.source: Construct a new encoder using the provided Cbor instance which only encodes types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 使用提供的 `Cbor` 实例构建一个新的编码器，该编码器仅对指定谓词返回 `true` 的类型进行编码。
